source_to_native.scope: Finite samples of every face; not a continuous Hausdorff bound.

cylinder_matching_method: Source hole, shaft, seat and unchanged fillet cylinders match native radii, axes and locations within 0.0001 mm. Explicitly recorded sampled-clearance replacements and recovered sketch arcs are checked by the unchanged full-surface and section gates.
bounds_note: Conservative BRep bounds can include untrimmed NURBS surface extents. Sampled boundary bounds use a 0.02 mm tessellation and describe the trimmed physical boundary.
scope: Exact native STEP geometry. Sampled symmetric surface checks are finite, not a mathematical Hausdorff proof. Native editability and assembly migration gates are separate.
